actions.task_instruction: Place the blue block at the center of the black mat to serve as the base.
Stack the green block on top of the blue block.
Stack the red block on top of the green block.
Move the blue and green block stack from the white mat to the center of the black mat.
Stack the red block on top of the green block on the black mat.

resolved_task.confirmed_intent: Stack the blue, green, and red blocks with blue at the bottom, green in the middle, and red on top.

episodes.summary: The user requested to stack blue, green, and red blocks in that order from bottom to top, but the task failed as the red block remained separate and the blue/green stack was not moved to the center black mat.
episodes.user_request: Stack the blocks in blue, green, red order from bottom to top.
episodes.user_visible_result: The blocks were not stacked correctly. The red block is separate, and the blue/green stack is still on the white mat instead of the center zone.

discrepancies: The red block is not stacked on the green block.
The stack is not in the center zone (black mat); the blue/green blocks are on the white mat.

failure.description: The blocks were not stacked in the correct order/location. The red block is separate, and the blue/green stack is on the white mat instead of the black mat.

evaluation-participant.text: The user attempted to stack blue, green, and red blocks in a specific bottom-to-top order, but the task failed because the red block was not added to the stack and the stack was not moved to the center black mat.
